brief:
Part: cantilever bracket, load at the tip. Solid rectangular cross-section, width across the load, thickness in the load direction.
Load 600 N at the tip, length 150 mm.
REQ-001 yield margin of safety >= 0 with factor 1.25 (MS = allowable / (factor x stress) - 1).
REQ-002 ultimate margin of safety >= 0 with factor 1.4.
REQ-003 tip deflection <= 1.5 mm.
REQ-004 width 20-80 mm, thickness 3-8 mm.
REQ-005 thickness must be a stock plate thickness: [3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 30] mm.
REQ-006 REQ-001 to REQ-003 must still hold with the load 10% higher and the plate 0.5 mm thinner.
REQ-007 thickness / width <= 2 (a proxy for lateral stability).

summary: The Steel 4130, 69 x 8 mm space bracket passes all structural and performance checks (S-01 to S-06, F-01 to F-03), with the lowest margin at MS +1.27 (S-03) and tip deflection of 1.12 mm (S-04). Open items remain in materials and process (M-01, M-04, M-05), fracture control and fatigue (X-01, X-02), and supplier and sourcing compliance (P-01 to P-03), so the design is not yet release-ready.
top_risks: Material allowables are unconfirmed: M-01 uses typical handbook values, so the passing margins in S-01 to S-03 may not hold once MMPDS A- or B-basis values are applied.
Corrosion and galvanic risk: 4130 rusts (M-04) and the joint has dissimilar metals (M-05), so the finish and fastener choice are open and could affect the joint's life and the margins.
Fracture and fatigue are unassessed: X-01 has no fracture-critical classification and X-02 has no cyclic load analysis for launch vibration, so the part cannot yet be cleared for flight.

actions.action: Replace the typical handbook values with MMPDS A- or B-basis allowables for AMS 6350 at the 8 mm thickness, then rerun S-01 to S-03 with those values.
Run a fatigue analysis using the program's cyclic load cases, including launch vibration, and report the results.
Classify the bracket under NASA-STD-5019 (for example, non-fracture-critical) and record the rationale.
Specify a corrosion protection finish (plating, or primer and paint) per the program finish spec.
Specify fastener material and finish compatible with 4130 under MIL-STD-889 to avoid galvanic corrosion at the joint.

memo: Recommendation: Award the order for 10 Steel 4130 brackets to Vendor B (sample), which submitted a bid at $6,488.12 each with a 13-day lead time and is eligible with no flags. Vendor B was selected by the scoring model, which weighted price at 0.6 and lead time at 0.4, and it beat Vendor A (sample), which bid $6,684.23 each with an 18-day lead time and was also eligible. Vendor C (sample) was not chosen because it lacks an AS9100 quality system, and Vendor D (sample) was not chosen because it cannot certify a DFARS-compliant melt source, so both were ineligible and submitted no bid.
